The server fails CLOSED — no task data crosses without a valid dataset-scoped token. (Cross-ref: ve-w2-mcp-deploy recorded its own live smoke green 2026-07-11 ~14:32Z.)

## Status

**wave: COMPLETE (reviewed 2026-07-11; original in-flight note follows for the record)** — building — 2 slices in flight (`mcp-close-doc-truth` → `mcp-epic-close-stamp`). Charter decisions 12-21 committed as 6c6b29c7. Builders claim first; the doc slice's PR carries `Task: mcp-close-doc-truth`; Go-prose-only merges on the Go gate + doc gates; the close slice seals the epic with epoch 0 and the lead re-reads at Review. Backlog filed: none (ledger swept clean).


## DEBRIEF (Review, 2026-07-11 — the wave closes here)

**Grade: A.** Both slices green; the epic is SEALED.

### What shipped

- **`mcp-close-doc-truth`** — final branch **`loop-epic/doc-truth-refresh-every-mcp-surface-says-0-r`** (merge THIS, not the base). Every MCP surface now says EIGHT curated task tools: 9 onramp docs, in-binary help, 7 stale source comments (2 beyond the brief — 'curated'/'six' split across newlines in mcp_bridge.go:49 and mcp_stdio_smoke_test.go:208, invisible to the line grep), the @canonical aka list (full 8 names, marker still adjacent to registerTaskTools), and validation.md (six→eight; the "(401)" deny expectation corrected to a tool-result error isError:true/unauthorized inside HTTP 200; "transcript pending" replaced by this Paper's dated redacted live-smoke addendum, zero token bytes — grep-verified). The stamp/pulse verb lines went in at the canonical `renderAgentsMDBody` source so the .mdc, CLAUDE-BARKPARK.md, the CODEX.md AGENTS block and the golden stay byte-parity (20 files; the 3 beyond the brief were mechanically forced by TestOnrampAgentsMdWrapperParity — reviewer ratifies the judgment: stamp/pulse are real CLI verbs and belong in the shell teach-body). Reviewer verified the taught syntax byte-accurate against the live manifest (task.stamp args doc_id/worker_id/observed_epoch + --criterion/--met/--evidence/--miss/--note; task.pulse epoch-free) and confirmed in api/lib/barkpark/tasks/pulse.ex that pulse really does bump the claim epoch — the "re-read it before the next close" warning the docs now carry is true and load-bearing. **One reviewer fix (dc7371c7):** the builder left validation.md's "Still owed: the live remote smoke" pointer contradicting the new addendum 30 lines below — the exact staleness class the slice was purging; retired with a see-below pointer. Historical numeral run-logs (5-tool/6-tool snapshots) correctly preserved as point-in-time records. Full slice gate re-run green on the -r branch: build/vet/test, zero six-hits, docs-anchors-check PASS, check-doc-budgets PASS.
- **`mcp-epic-close-stamp`** — ledger-only, zero repo commits (its branch is empty vs main; nothing to merge). **`bp-mcp-serve-epic` is CLOSED done+published**, draft collapsed (drafts.bp-mcp-serve-epic → not_found), sealed via the close verb only at epoch 0. The close story is provenance-exact: anchor→evidence clause map at cbef2af2; #1790=cac9b43d, #1791=398612d2, #1993=94efd1f5, Path A d49b7c40 intact; cross-epic corroboration #2588=304e45fb + #2580=46f7ea5d cited by id+sha as other epics' deliverables; D18 attributed to viable-everywhere's charter (05c42173), distinct from this epic's own mcp-w2-resources degrade; OAuth disclaimed by name as ve-w3-oauth-as (REMOTE.md:7/90); live proof scoped to read + fail-closed only; doc-truth named the blessed open child; downstream consumers cited, not re-homed; original anchor preserved verbatim. Reviewer independently re-verified every cited anchor via `git show cbef2af2` (mcp_tasks.go:113/152/194/226/319 registrations, :70-71 naming note, mcp_bridge.go:80) and resolved all seven shas to exactly the commits claimed; the 47/47 arithmetic (5+7+5+5+5+7+7+6) checks.

### What stalled

Nothing. One review-time footnote: mcp-epic-close-stamp's criterion 5 (LEAD GATE — "lead re-read the closed epic and confirms the stamp trail is honest") could not be stamped at review because the builder's claim lease was still live (worker epic-builder-epic-close-out-bp-mcp-serve-epic-sealed-, epoch 6) and the claim verb correctly refused a second holder. The reviewer HAS done the re-read — every anchor and sha verified — so the lead's close after the lease lapses is a formality; evidence to cite: this debrief.

### Ledger audit

Both slice tasks claimed before work, pulsed at phase boundaries, stamped mid-claim with concrete evidence, and left honestly `in_progress` with only their gate criteria open (doc-truth c5 = MERGE-GATE, close-stamp c5 = LEAD GATE). No lies found, no reopens needed. Reviewer's one ledger write: `review_note` on mcp-close-doc-truth naming the -r merge target and the gate re-run (published). No task outside the wave was touched. Backlog: none — correct, the sweep found nothing to file.

### Grade commentary (earning the A)

Strong: the close story is the best of the reconcile-and-close line — every clause of a two-wave-old anchor pinned to file:line at a named sha with the owning PR, cross-epic evidence cited without appropriation, and the two provenance traps the verify round flagged (D18 ownership, task_show naming) handled exactly as ratified. The doc slice's parity discipline (fix at the canonical source, let the embeds regenerate) is how doc-truth work should always be done, and its builder_review was honest about every scope excursion. Short of A+: the builder left one fresh internal contradiction in the very file whose staleness the slice existed to purge (the "Still owed" pointer — a careful same-file read would have caught it), and the close-stamp lease overlap means the wave ends with the seal's own audit criterion open — a sequencing wrinkle (the builder's final pulse kept the lease warm into Review) worth fixing in the epic-cycle contract, not in this wave's work.

### For the lead (merge order + closes)

1. Merge **`loop-epic/doc-truth-refresh-every-mcp-surface-says-0-r`** (b6d5d9d0 + dc7371c7 + charter wave-log 1798d069). Go-prose/docs only — merges on the Go gate + doc gates per the Go/doc-only carve-out.
2. Close mcp-close-doc-truth criterion 5 (MERGE-GATE) and the task.
3. After the builder lease lapses, re-claim mcp-epic-close-stamp, stamp criterion 5 met citing this debrief, close the task.
4. `loop-epic/epic-close-out-bp-mcp-serve-epic-sealed--1` has no commits — delete it, nothing to merge.

### Next wave

None. The epic is sealed, its roadmap mined out (charter: "After wave 3 the epic is CLOSED"). MCP-flavored work now lives with viable-everywhere (ve-w3-oauth-as OAuth for Claude.ai remote, ve-bl-mcp-http-ingest-ambient) and studio-claude-chat (task-scc-bl-mcp-chat-toolset). The one exportable lesson: builders of ledger-only seal slices should RELEASE their claim (or let it lapse) once done, so Review can pass the seal's own audit gate in-wave.</article>

# bp mcp serve — Reconcile-and-Close Wave of 2026-07-11

**Epic anchor:** `bp-mcp-serve-epic` — "bp mcp serve — MCP server for Barkpark Tasks (Cursor path B)". 8/8 children done, every child criterion met, epic still `open`. *(Correction, Review 2026-07-11: the epic is now `done`+published — see the Debrief below.)*

## The Wish (verbatim)

Verify the anchor's own criteria at HEAD, stamp with the PR trail (#1790/#1791/#1993 + the #2588 transport as corroborating evidence, cited cross-epic by id+sha per the dedup law), and CLOSE the epic if its words are fully evidenced — the ledger sweep pattern. If the anchor names genuinely unbuilt scope, name the honest remainder or re-home it. Zero build slices expected; every stamp = file:line + PR + run evidence. Hard laws: never close over an unverified criterion; publish-collapse any drafts.* touch; human gates stay open with recipes; builders claim first if any slice exists.

## Strategy (wave direction)

This is a **zero-build reconciliation wave**. The finished experience: the epic closed with a stamp trail where every clause of the anchor's description is matched to evidence at HEAD — file:line in `internal/cli/mcp_*.go`, the owning PR, and a fresh run proof (stdio smoke + go test at HEAD, not a memory of green). The #2588 remote transport and #2580 task_stamp/task_pulse tools are **corroborating cross-epic evidence** (cited by id+sha, owned elsewhere) proving the stdio core this epic built became the shared seam for two later epics — the strongest possible "done" signal.

Leaning toward CLOSE. Anchor scope check: core five tools (task_ready, task_next, task_show, task_close, task_create) → w1-core; manifest-machinery reuse → w1-seam; stretch bridge → w1-bridge; Cursor docs → w1-docs; plus w2 (catalog/resources/validation). Two suspected wrinkles the fleets must settle:

1. **Naming drift** — the anchor says `task_show`; the CLI verb is `task get`. Is the MCP tool actually named `task_show` at HEAD, or did it drift? A rename is fine, but the stamp must say so honestly.
2. **Doc staleness** — did #2588 (--http) or #2580 (new tools) leave CURSOR.md / HANDBOOK / `docs/ops/mcp-serve-validation.md` describing a smaller server than HEAD ships? Staleness is at most a residue task, not a blocker, unless a documented recipe is now WRONG.

OAuth for Claude.ai remote is **explicitly not this epic's scope** — it is viable-everywhere w3. The close-out will disclaim it by name so nobody reopens this epic for it.

## Survey plan (in flight NOW — 13 Sonnet surveyors)

1. **anchor-criteria** — What exactly are the anchor's own words/criteria (raw doc at HEAD)? Does the epic doc carry acceptance_criteria of its own, or only the description + children? → defines the exact checklist we must evidence before closing.
2. **core-tools-at-head** — Do the five curated task tools exist at HEAD in `internal/cli/mcp_tasks.go`/`mcp_serve.go`? Exact registered tool names (task_show vs task_get drift), file:line map. → the stamp's core evidence; naming drift must be named.
3. **bridge-at-head** — `mcp_bridge.go`: generic capabilities→MCP bridge, `--tools all`, curated-overlay shadowing — still intact at HEAD? file:line. → evidences the stretch clause.
4. **resources-at-head** — `mcp_resources.go`: Papers as `barkpark://papers/{id}` resources still listed/readable after #2588 layered HTTP on. → evidences w2-resources at HEAD, not just at merge.
5. **stdout-purity-smoke** — Run the stdio smoke + `go test ./internal/cli/ -run 'Mcp|MCP'` at HEAD; capture output. → the "run evidence" half of every stamp; distrust vacuous green.
6. **docs-trail** — CURSOR.md, HANDBOOK MCP section, `.cursor/rules/barkpark-tasks.mdc`, `docs/ops/mcp-serve-validation.md`: do documented recipes match HEAD behavior post-#2588/#2580? → wrong recipe = residue task; stale-but-true = note only.
7. **pr-trail** — Merge shas + delivered scope for #1790, #1791, #1993; plus #2588 and #2580 shas as cross-epic corroborators. → the id+sha citations the dedup law requires.
8. **cursor-path-b-remainder** — Any Cursor-specific path-B scope unbuilt? Path A = `.cursor/rules/barkpark-tasks.mdc` (d49b7c40); search ledger + repo for open Cursor items. → the honest-remainder clause of the wish.
9. **oauth-rehome** — Confirm OAuth-for-Claude.ai-remote is owned by viable-everywhere w3 (find that epic's task/paper ids). → lets the close-out disclaim it with a pointer, not a shrug.
10. **ledger-residue** — Sweep bp for open/ready/claimed tasks or drafts.* touching mcp-serve beyond the 8 children. → hard law: publish-collapse drafts; no orphaned residue at close.
11. **http-vs-stdio-seam** — How #2588 layered `--http` (`mcp_http_test.go`) on the stdio server: shared tool registry? One seam or a fork? file:line. → the corroboration story must be architecturally true, not vibes.
12. **validation-doc-freshness** — Is the `mcp-serve-validation.md` transcript (vs live guerrilla) still valid evidence at HEAD? Does guerrilla currently serve the MCP endpoint? → decides whether a fresh live transcript is needed before stamping w2-validation.
13. **epic-close-mechanics** — How did prior reconcile-and-close waves (pd-everything-editable, self-update wave 7) stamp and close their epics — exact field shapes, close verb sequence, epoch/claim handling? → our close must match house style and the task write contract.


## Survey digest (Digest phase, 2026-07-11)

12 surveyor reports in. The picture is unusually settled — this stays a **zero-build reconcile-and-close**, and both suspected wrinkles resolved cleanly (one dissolved, one confirmed as a single doc-residue slice).

### Established (evidence-anchored)

- **The epic doc carries NO acceptance_criteria of its own** — prose description only (`bp task get bp-mcp-serve-epic`: content keys are description/github/kind/lifecycle_status/priority/wave_paper/wave_status). All acceptance evidence lives on the 8 children: 47/47 criteria met, all `lifecycle_status=done`, all published, all with closed claims. Close shape therefore follows the self-update-epic precedent: rewrite the epic description as a PR-cited close story (patch+publish first), then `bp task close bp-mcp-serve-epic <worker> 0 done <reason>` — the epic is unclaimed (claim=null), so epoch 0 is accepted; there is no open-children guard; lifecycle flips go through `bp task close` ONLY, never raw mutate.
- **Every anchor clause maps to HEAD evidence** (HEAD = cbef2af2):
  - stdio `mcp serve` subcommand — `internal/cli/mcp_serve.go` (runMCPServe :60, buildMCPServer :137), PR #1790 = sha `cac9b43d`.
  - Core five tools, named EXACTLY as the anchor writes them — `mcp_tasks.go` Name: task_ready :113, task_next :152, task_show :194, task_close :226, task_create :319.
  - Manifest-machinery reuse — execManifestCommand seam; bridge handlers dispatch through the same run.go path (mcp_bridge.go:100-101).
  - Stretch capabilities→MCP bridge — registerBridgeTools mcp_bridge.go:80, shadow set :65-73, `--tools all` gate mcp_serve.go:157-161. Bridge tests 6/6 PASS at HEAD (run fresh this wave).
  - Cursor docs — CURSOR.md:76-93 documents both `~/.cursor/mcp.json` and per-project `.cursor/mcp.json`; PR #1791 = sha `398612d2` (docs-only, confirmed via diffstat).
  - Wave-2 (catalog/resources/validation) — PR #1993 = sha `94efd1f5`; Papers as `barkpark://papers/{id}` resources intact at HEAD (mcp_resources.go:91-97, :239-262).
  - Path A pointer — commit `d49b7c40` real, `.cursor/rules/barkpark-tasks.mdc` intact (last touched by #2129, content unchanged in substance).
- **Fresh run proofs already produced this wave** (not remembered green): `CC=/usr/bin/clang go build ./...` clean; 24/24 tests across all mcp_*.go files PASS at HEAD (two independent surveyor runs); TestMCPServeStdioSmoke exec's the REAL bp binary over real pipes (12.35s, byte-pure stdout, asserts the 8-tool catalog); live curl against `https://guerrilla.barkpark.cloud/mcp` → real initialize handshake (protocolVersion 2025-06-18, serverInfo barkpark-tasks) + tools/list returning all 8 tools, HTTP 200.
- **Wrinkle 1 (task_show naming) DISSOLVED** — the registered MCP tool IS named `task_show`, matching the anchor verbatim. The underlying manifest verb is `task.get`, and the divergence is deliberate and documented in-source (mcp_tasks.go:70-71 "the tool keeps its show-vs-get name for MCP-client familiarity") and in mcp-w1-core criterion 2's evidence. The close stamp cites that comment; nothing to fix.
- **Wrinkle 2 (doc staleness) CONFIRMED as one residue slice** — HEAD ships EIGHT curated tools (5 anchor + task_prime from #1993, task_stamp/task_pulse from #2580); three surfaces still say "six" = WRONG-recipe: `docs/setup/CURSOR.md:113`, `docs/cli/HANDBOOK.md:165` (also omits `--http`), and the IN-BINARY help `mcp_serve.go:382-384` (printMCPServeHelp). Plus stale-but-true: `docs/ops/mcp-serve-validation.md` has no 8-tool entry and its "--http … Status: transcript pending" line is now FALSE (live smoke green 2026-07-11 ~14:32Z per ve-w2-mcp-deploy, other epic); and the @canonical aka list at mcp_tasks.go:75 omits task_show/task_create. Root cause is timing: #2588 (`304e45fb`, 15:31) then #2580 (`46f7ea5d`, 16:29) an hour later touched only code, no docs.
- **The corroboration story is architecturally true** — buildMCPServer is the single assembly point for both transports; #2588's own commit message states "zero edits to mcp_tasks.go / mcp_bridge.go / mcp_resources.go"; #2580 extended mcp_tasks.go (+202) on the same registry after the transport split. ## Verification results (deep round, 2026-07-11, HEAD cbef2af2)

**bp-mcp-serve-epic-criteria-close-pack — PROVEN.** mcp-w1-bridge 5/5 and mcp-w1-seam 5/5 criteria quoted verbatim with evidence (curated-five shadowing: "bridgeShadowedIDs={task.ready,task.next,task.get,task.close}. TestBridgeShadowing … PASS"; seam: `execManifestCommand(g globals, ctx manifest.Context, m *manifest.Manifest, cmd manifest.Command, tail []string) (int, []byte, error)` in run.go, "grep-verified CLEAN" of renderer bypass). **doc-residue-precision — WRINKLE 2 CONFIRMED AND WIDENED.** The "six" staleness is not 3 files but 15 surfaces: 9 docs (CURSOR.md:113, CODEX.md:174, CLAUDE-CODE.md:135, WINDSURF.md:91, COPILOT.md:125, ZED.md:99, GEMINI-CLI.md:96, AGENT-ONRAMPS.md:107, HANDBOOK.md:165), the in-binary help (mcp_serve.go:382-384 — proven stale by building HEAD and running `mcp serve --help`), 5 source comments beside already-correct 8-tool assertions (mcp_stdio_smoke_test.go:8, mcp_bridge.go:28, mcp_http_test.go:219, mcp_serve_test.go:45/:133), plus the @canonical aka list (mcp_tasks.go:75 omits task_show/task_create). validation.md additionally: :145 "curated six", :184 "transcript pending" now FALSE (ve-w2-mcp-deploy's live smoke green 2026-07-11 ~14:32Z). Full unfiltered Go gate green at HEAD: `ok github.com/FRIKKern/barkpark/internal/cli 10.778s` (re-confirmed by Decide's own dry-run, exit 0).

## Decisions (ratified — charter decisions 12-21, commit 6c6b29c7)

1. **CLOSE the epic this wave** — every anchor clause evidenced at HEAD with fresh proof; leaving it open is ledger rot (D12).
2. **Close mechanics = self-update precedent** — description rewrite via patch+publish, then `bp task close bp-mcp-serve-epic <worker> 0 done`; never raw-mutate lifecycle (D13).

## Wave plan (2 slices, integration-ordered — builders claim first)

| # | Task | Surface | Builder | Size | Gate |

| 1 | `mcp-close-doc-truth` | docs + Go prose (9 docs, help string, 5 comments, aka list, validation addendum, .mdc verbs) | opus | medium | `CC=/usr/bin/clang go build ./... && go vet ./internal/cli/... && CC=/usr/bin/clang go test ./internal/cli/... && ! grep -rn 'curated six\|Six curated\|six curated' docs/ internal/cli/ .cursor/ && scripts/docs-anchors-check.sh && scripts/check-doc-budgets.sh` |

## Live smoke addendum (for mcp-close-doc-truth to paste into docs/ops/mcp-serve-validation.md — token redacted, verified by the live-http-tools-call verifier)

> ## Live smoke — guerrilla remote, 2026-07-11 (transcript no longer pending)

> Endpoint: https://guerrilla.barkpark.cloud/mcp (Streamable-HTTP). Binary HEAD cbef2af2. Admin token from ~/.config/barkpark/config.json known_servers[guerrilla], passed as `Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>`; no token byte appears below.

**wave: COMPLETE (reviewed 2026-07-11; original in-flight note follows for the record)** — building — 2 slices in flight (`mcp-close-doc-truth` → `mcp-epic-close-stamp`). ## DEBRIEF (Review, 2026-07-11 — the wave closes here)

**Grade: A.** Both slices green; the epic is SEALED.

### What shipped

- **`mcp-close-doc-truth`** — final branch **`loop-epic/doc-truth-refresh-every-mcp-surface-says-0-r`** (merge THIS, not the base). Every MCP surface now says EIGHT curated task tools: 9 onramp docs, in-binary help, 7 stale source comments (2 beyond the brief — 'curated'/'six' split across newlines in mcp_bridge.go:49 and mcp_stdio_smoke_test.go:208, invisible to the line grep), the @canonical aka list (full 8 names, marker still adjacent to registerTaskTools), and validation.md (six→eight; the "(401)" deny expectation corrected to a tool-result error isError:true/unauthorized inside HTTP 200; "transcript pending" replaced by this Paper's dated redacted live-smoke addendum, zero token bytes — grep-verified). The stamp/pulse verb lines went in at the canonical `renderAgentsMDBody` source so the .mdc, CLAUDE-BARKPARK.md, the CODEX.md AGENTS block and the golden stay byte-parity (20 files; the 3 beyond the brief were mechanically forced by TestOnrampAgentsMdWrapperParity — reviewer ratifies the judgment: stamp/pulse are real CLI verbs and belong in the shell teach-body). Reviewer verified the taught syntax byte-accurate against the live manifest (task.stamp args doc_id/worker_id/observed_epoch + --criterion/--met/--evidence/--miss/--note; task.pulse epoch-free) and confirmed in api/lib/barkpark/tasks/pulse.ex that pulse really does bump the claim epoch — the "re-read it before the next close" warning the docs now carry is true and load-bearing. **One reviewer fix (dc7371c7):** the builder left validation.md's "Still owed: the live remote smoke" pointer contradicting the new addendum 30 lines below — the exact staleness class the slice was purging; retired with a see-below pointer. Historical numeral run-logs (5-tool/6-tool snapshots) correctly preserved as point-in-time records. Full slice gate re-run green on the -r branch: build/vet/test, zero six-hits, docs-anchors-check PASS, check-doc-budgets PASS.
- **`mcp-epic-close-stamp`** — ledger-only, zero repo commits (its branch is empty vs main; nothing to merge). **`bp-mcp-serve-epic` is CLOSED done+published**, draft collapsed (drafts.bp-mcp-serve-epic → not_found), sealed via the close verb only at epoch 0. The close story is provenance-exact: anchor→evidence clause map at cbef2af2; #1790=cac9b43d, #1791=398612d2, #1993=94efd1f5, Path A d49b7c40 intact; cross-epic corroboration #2588=304e45fb + #2580=46f7ea5d cited by id+sha as other epics' deliverables; D18 attributed to viable-everywhere's charter (05c42173), distinct from this epic's own mcp-w2-resources degrade; OAuth disclaimed by name as ve-w3-oauth-as (REMOTE.md:7/90); live proof scoped to read + fail-closed only; doc-truth named the blessed open child; downstream consumers cited, not re-homed; original anchor preserved verbatim. Reviewer independently re-verified every cited anchor via `git show cbef2af2` (mcp_tasks.go:113/152/194/226/319 registrations, :70-71 naming note, mcp_bridge.go:80) and resolved all seven shas to exactly the commits claimed; the 47/47 arithmetic (5+7+5+5+5+7+7+6) checks.

### What stalled

Nothing. One review-time footnote: mcp-epic-close-stamp's criterion 5 (LEAD GATE — "lead re-read the closed epic and confirms the stamp trail is honest") could not be stamped at review because the builder's claim lease was still live (worker epic-builder-epic-close-out-bp-mcp-serve-epic-sealed-, epoch 6) and the claim verb correctly refused a second holder. The reviewer HAS done the re-read — every anchor and sha verified — so the lead's close after the lease lapses is a formality; evidence to cite: this debrief.

### Ledger audit

Both slice tasks claimed before work, pulsed at phase boundaries, stamped mid-claim with concrete evidence, and left honestly `in_progress` with only their gate criteria open (doc-truth c5 = MERGE-GATE, close-stamp c5 = LEAD GATE). No lies found, no reopens needed. Reviewer's one ledger write: `review_note` on mcp-close-doc-truth naming the -r merge target and the gate re-run (published). No task outside the wave was touched. Backlog: none — correct, the sweep found nothing to file.

### Grade commentary (earning the A)

Strong: the close story is the best of the reconcile-and-close line — every clause of a two-wave-old anchor pinned to file:line at a named sha with the owning PR, cross-epic evidence cited without appropriation, and the two provenance traps the verify round flagged (D18 ownership, task_show naming) handled exactly as ratified. The doc slice's parity discipline (fix at the canonical source, let the embeds regenerate) is how doc-truth work should always be done, and its builder_review was honest about every scope excursion. Short of A+: the builder left one fresh internal contradiction in the very file whose staleness the slice existed to purge (the "Still owed" pointer — a careful same-file read would have caught it), and the close-stamp lease overlap means the wave ends with the seal's own audit criterion open — a sequencing wrinkle (the builder's final pulse kept the lease warm into Review) worth fixing in the epic-cycle contract, not in this wave's work.

### For the lead (merge order + closes)

1. Merge **`loop-epic/doc-truth-refresh-every-mcp-surface-says-0-r`** (b6d5d9d0 + dc7371c7 + charter wave-log 1798d069). Go-prose/docs only — merges on the Go gate + doc gates per the Go/doc-only carve-out.
2. Close mcp-close-doc-truth criterion 5 (MERGE-GATE) and the task.
3. After the builder lease lapses, re-claim mcp-epic-close-stamp, stamp criterion 5 met citing this debrief, close the task.
4. `loop-epic/epic-close-out-bp-mcp-serve-epic-sealed--1` has no commits — delete it, nothing to merge.

### Next wave

None. The epic is sealed, its roadmap mined out (charter: "After wave 3 the epic is CLOSED"). MCP-flavored work now lives with viable-everywhere (ve-w3-oauth-as OAuth for Claude.ai remote, ve-bl-mcp-http-ingest-ambient) and studio-claude-chat (task-scc-bl-mcp-chat-toolset). The one exportable lesson: builders of ledger-only seal slices should RELEASE their claim (or let it lapse) once done, so Review can pass the seal's own audit gate in-wave.

# Cloud Console — Reconcile-the-Anchor Wave (2026-07-11)

**Epic anchor:** `cloud-console-goal` (p0, lifecycle `open`, 22/22 children done, **0/6 criteria stamped** despite five shipped waves C1–C7 + w2–w5). Charter: `.claude/workflows/bp-cloud-console-charter.md`.

**Status: REVIEWED / CLOSED as the wave debrief (2026-07-12)** — Elixir train MERGED (#2648/#2649/#2650); webhook pair review-green on `loop-epic/land-the-webhook-full-edit-pair-cli-verb-1-r`, awaiting the lead's merge; anchor endgame honestly stalled on its precondition (re-dispatch after the webhook merge). Goal still open at 3/6 — never stamped over the gap. See DEBRIEF at the bottom. *(Correction note: this line previously read 'webhook-edit-gui unbuilt' — that premise was FALSE, corrected at Decide round 2 / OC29: the GUI was built at 765dcacd.)*

## The Wish (verbatim)

CLOUD CONSOLE — RECONCILE THE ANCHOR + TAKE THE HONEST NEXT LEVER. (1) verify each anchor criterion at HEAD with file:line + PR + fresh run/live proof — stamp what is TRUE (the meters/quotas criterion is likely fully evidenced by w2+w5; webhooks GUI shipped in C-waves — verify it end-to-end, not from memory). (2) For criteria with REAL gaps (candidates: Plan tab parked on plan truth cloud-17; any dead/decorative panel; audit-event coverage holes), either cut honest build slices this wave or park with a named blocker — never stamp over a gap. (3) Consume or retire the charter's stale next-wave pointers (machine-meter is DONE; live TREND eyeball is a lead/human ritual — park with recipe if unautomatable; worst-state accents stay parked on cloud-17). If all six criteria end met, close the goal via the close verb; if not, leave it open with the residue filed as children. Hard laws: never close over an unverified criterion; publish-collapse every drafts.* touch (sweep drafts.cloud-console-c10-members-usage, -c11-live-meters, -rollback-gui, -dec-*); human gates stay open with recipes; builders claim their bp task FIRST; Elixir changes wait for the Elixir Test gate; guerrilla deploys ONLY via instance-deploy.sh. File residue under cloud-console-goal.

## Strategy (wave direction)

This is the **honest-audit endgame wave**, not a feature wave. Five waves of building outran the ledger; the deliverable now is a stamp trail, not a screen. The finished state:

1. **Each of the six anchor criteria carries evidence at HEAD** — file:line + PR# + a fresh run or live-guerrilla proof — and is stamped `met:true` only where the words are actually true. Expected verdicts going in (to be overturned by evidence, not memory):
   - *meters = per-instance truth + quotas + warnings* — likely fully evidenced: w2 quota truth (#1966), w3 sampler, w4 history/sparklines, w5 machine meters (task-7100934ee7f33579, live-proven on guerrilla 2026-07-10). The honest-quota doctrine holds: ONE enforcement-backed ceiling (instances, OC11), all other meters honestly nil — if the criterion's letter demands ceilings that don't exist in plan truth, we amend the criterion with a decision note citing cloud-17, we do NOT invent ceilings.
   - *webhooks GUI-controllable* — shipped in C-waves + webhook_gone honesty (OC4); needs a true end-to-end verify (every verb reachable from the GUI, not just list).
   - *every reference tab live+tested* — the criterion's 10-tab list predates the frozen IA (D17: 4 places + Settings; capability = sub-tabs/lenses). Suspected real gap: **Plan** (parked on plan truth cloud-17). The likely honest move: reconcile the criterion against the shipped IA, stamp the live-tabs truth table, park Plan with the named blocker.
   - *every mutation audited* — the LEAST verified criterion; a route-by-route coverage map is the wave's most likely source of real build slices.
   - *no decorative UI* — sweep for dead panels; OC22's honestly-inert accent code is NOT decoration (it renders nothing) — decoration means painted-but-fake.
   - *browser never holds instance tokens* — architecture says vault-token seam is server-side only; needs a grep-proof + response-shape audit, cheap to verify.
2. **Real gaps become honest slices or parked children** — audit-event holes cut as build slices this wave if small; Plan tab parked on cloud-17 with a named blocker; live TREND eyeball parked with a human recipe if unautomatable.
3. **The ledger is left clean**: all `drafts.cloud-console-*` children publish-collapsed or retired (three dec-* records are `done` with 0/N criteria stamped — reconcile or retire them as decision records; c11 sits at 2/3 — find the unmet criterion and resolve it honestly); charter's stale next-wave pointers consumed (machine-meter DONE) or retired.
4. **The goal closes via the close verb only if 6/6 end true** — otherwise it stays open with residue filed as children. Lean: expect 1–2 small build slices max (audit holes, a webhook GUI verb gap); everything else is verification + ledger hygiene.

Quality bar: Kinsta/Vercel completeness = no dead panel, every number sourced, every lever wired. A stamp without a run proof is a lie (distrust vacuous green).

## Survey plan (12 scouts, one question each)

1. **tab-backend-truth-table** — Map the ACTUAL shipped console IA in `cloud/priv/static/app.js` (INSTANCE_TABS, SETTINGS_VIEWS, nav places) against criterion 0's list (Overview/Members/Studios/API/Datasets/Access/Activity/Usage/Plan/Settings): per tab, the serving backend route in `cloud/lib/barkpark_cloud/*/router.ex` + its test file. Name any tab missing/dead/backend-less. *Why: criterion 0 needs a per-tab truth table; Plan is the suspected gap.*
2. **webhooks-gui-e2e** — Map the complete webhook GUI capability chain: which webhook verbs (list/create/rotate/deliveries/replay/delete/edit) exist in app.js, their routes, tests, and the webhook_gone/capability_unavailable honesty branch. Name any verb still curl-only. *Why: criterion 1, the epic's explicit top user priority — verify end-to-end, not from memory.*
3. **meters-quota-evidence** — Assemble criterion 2's evidence pack at HEAD: the /usage envelope's full meter set (9 + w5 machine meters), quota/warn on the instances meter (OC11 rules), warn/over rendering in SPA + CLI, sampler + history + machine meters, with file:line + PR#s + test names. State exactly which meters lack quotas and the cloud-17 dependency. *Why: this stamp should be the easiest — make it airtight.*
4. **audit-event-coverage** — Enumerate EVERY mutating route (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) in the cloud control plane and check which emit an audit/activity event (find the emission seam, grep each route). Produce the hole list with file:line. *Why: criterion 4 is the least-verified and the likeliest source of real build slices.*
5. **token-hygiene-proof** — Prove criterion 5: grep app.js + all router response shapes for any path where an instance admin/vault token could reach the browser (reveal_admin_token call sites, SSE payloads, error tuples, localStorage). *Why: architecture says server-side only — turn that into a cited proof or a named leak.*
6. **decorative-ui-sweep** — Hunt painted-but-fake UI in app.js + __preview__: panels with no live backend, buttons wired to nothing, placeholder numbers, spinners without recovery actions (D25). Distinguish honestly-inert code (OC22 accents) from decoration. *Why: criterion 3 needs a negative-space proof.*
7. **drafts-ledger-sweep** — List every drafts.cloud-console-* doc (c10, c11, rollback-gui, dec-webhook-path, dec-metering, dec-ia): current draft/published state, why the three dec-* are done with 0/N criteria, what c11's unmet 3rd criterion says, and the exact publish-collapse or retire recipe per doc. *Why: hard law — every drafts.* touch publish-collapses; the sweep is mandated by the wish.*
8. **charter-pointer-reconcile** — Verify the charter's wave-5/next-wave pointers against reality: machine-meter task-7100934ee7f33579 (done 6/6 — cite its PR + live proof), the live TREND eyeball ritual status, OC22/cloud-17 park. What should the charter's next-wave section say after this wave? *Why: the wish orders these pointers consumed or retired.*

**6. stamp-amendment-dry-run — the wish's assumed recipe was PARTLY WRONG.** Proven twice on scratch tasks: re-claim bumps the epoch but NEVER refreshes the frozen work-digest baseline — after amending criterion text under a live claim, close 409s again even after re-claim; the ONLY escape is `--set observed_rev=<fresh rev>` on the close. Also: `doc mutate` set keys are literal (amend = resend the WHOLE acceptance_criteria array), patch objects require `type`, close-as-blocked stays ready-eligible. Side-effect residue: rehearsal GitHub issue #2612 orphaned → closed at decide.

**Coverage not-founds worth keeping:** `cloud-17` is NOT a bp task (3 scouts) — superseded by the filed `cloud-console-billing-live-gate`; no webhook edit work in flight anywhere; fleet under the current CLI login is empty (0 instances), so live re-runs used code-level proofs.

Out-of-trail seams parked as named children, never silently skipped. *Why: 19/104 is honestly false; "every mutation" literally would flood the trail with machine polls and unhostable user-scoped events.*
- **OC25** — webhook full-edit is BUILT (GUI modal + CLI verb), criterion 1 unchanged. *Why: zero-Elixir, small, and narrowing the criterion would stamp over a product gap.*
- **OC26** — db_size gets the sentinel guard; criterion 2 stamps only AFTER the fix merges. *Why: a fake number is the exact lie D48/D51 exist to kill; never stamp over a live violation.*

Anchor claimed (`decide-cc-w6`), criteria 0 and 4 texts amended per OC23/OC24 (whole-array patch + publish), then **stamped 3/6 with evidence: criteria 0 (IA live+tested), 3 (decorative negative space clean), 5 (token custody)**. ### Wave plan — 5 slices, all published children of cloud-console-goal, all carrying wave_paper=cloud-console-wave-2026-07-11

All five gates dry-run green at decide on HEAD `39d27086`. Elixir slices wait for the Elixir Test gate before merge; guerrilla deploys only via instance-deploy.sh (auto on merge).

### Backlog filed (published children)

## Digest — round 2 (2026-07-12): resurvey after the interrupted build train

Context: the first cycle (2026-07-11) ran survey→verify→decide, stamped criteria 0/3/5, filed 5 build slices. The build train then ran PARTIALLY: four slices were BUILT on pushed branches with green gates, NONE merged; webhook-edit-gui was never built. A fresh 12-scout survey re-swept at today's HEAD; this digest reconciles it and dispatches the LAST verify round before the plan is cut.

### What is now established (evidence-anchored)

1. **Merge-state truth (settled by the digest itself, run 2026-07-12):** at `origin/main = 030b0108`, NONE of the four built w6 commits are ancestors — `30f59a6c` (dbsize-sentinel), `050f87ee` (audit-lifecycle), `c584cfc8` (audit-settings-sites), `22df63ab` (webhook-edit-cli) all NOT merged; `ce455233` (w5) is. The decorative-ui-sweep scout's claim that 050f87ee/22df63ab had merged is **REFUTED** (it read a worktree/`--all` log); the audit-coverage scout's "both branches unmerged, awaiting ordered LEAD merge" is **CONFIRMED**.

Fix built + regression-tested (usage_test.exs:272), issue #2619 open, task C0–C2 met, C3 (merge) awaits LEAD. Everything else about the criterion is airtight (13-meter envelope, honest-quota doctrine, 3-runtime fixture tripwire run fresh: 40/40).
4. **Criterion 4**: at the branches' base, 104 mutating routes / 19 audited / 26 hole-routes in two named clusters; the two audit branches close both clusters (5 + 20 new call sites, diff-confirmed). Merge ORDER is lifecycle → settings-sites (same files; settings-sites built to rebase over lifecycle).
5. **Criterion 1**: 7/8 webhook verbs GUI-wired end-to-end with a tested proxy + webhook_gone honesty branch (now at router.ex:7046-7072 — charter's OC4 cite of :5766 is stale). Full-edit (name/url/events/types) exists NOWHERE in the GUI and (at main) nowhere in the CLI; the upstream changeset supports it. Per OC25 the criterion stays as worded → the **GUI edit modal is the wave's one real remaining BUILD**; the CLI edit verb is built on the 22df63ab branch (unmerged).
6. **Criterion 5** re-proven with fresh runs (5/5 provisioning non-leak + 27/27 studio-link/rollback/self-update refute-token tests); SSE module has zero admin_token references; `/credentials` is the one deliberate, admin-gated, CLI-only escape hatch — never fetched by app.js (0 grep hits).
7. **Drafts sweep**: the six `drafts.cloud-console-*` ids are TASK-store records, not doc-store drafts (24 lookups not_found) — publish-collapse is a category error, confirming OC27. `c11-live-meters` is the one genuine false-done (criterion 3 met:false, empty evidence); correction task `cloud-console-c11-ledger-correction` (#2625) filed, gated on the dbsize merge. The three dec-* stubs are legitimately closed-as-superseded via close_reason pointers.
8. **Charter pointers**: all four wave-4/5 pointers verified consumed and accurate at HEAD. Sole residue: the stale `app.js:9180` ceiling comment, which rides the unbuilt webhook-edit-gui slice — must stay explicitly bundled or it drops off every plate.
9. **Live-guerrilla re-proof is a CREDENTIAL GATE** (proven twice live: this session's cloud team owns 0 barkparks). The w5 stamped evidence (task-7100934ee7f33579, real cron samples 2026-07-10) stands as the citation; Decide should accept it rather than spend a verifier on an unreachable box.
10. **Close mechanics** code-verified at source: fresh targeted claim (epoch 7→8, lifecycle open→in_progress), stamp per-criterion with evidence-or-miss, amending criterion TEXT freezes the work-digest → close must pass `--set observed_rev=<fresh rev>`, close never touches children/parent_id.

### Contradictions resolved / still open

- RESOLVED: merged-vs-unmerged (see 1). RESOLVED: the charter's "criterion 3 stamped at decide" note is real, not aspirational (goal task shows it, and the decorative sweep independently re-verified clean).
- OPEN → verify round: do the three Elixir branches merge CLEANLY onto today's main (drift since 39d27086: azure-restore #2610, provisioner #2609/#2614, MCP #2628 landed since — did any add unaudited team-facing mutating routes to cloud router.ex)? Do their gates pass FRESH post-merge, in order?
- OPEN → verify round: does `bp task stamp` reject stamps on a done task with a closed claim? (The c11 correction fallback recipe depends on the answer.)
- OPEN → verify round: does the webhook-edit-cli branch pass Go gates on top of today's main, and does its verb actually send a full-field PUT?

### Coverage map (NOT-FOUNDs are decisions-in-waiting)

**Checked + found:** full nav→route→test truth table (14 shipped places, every one live + tested; members coverage hides in the misleadingly-named router_invitations_test.exs); webhook capability chain (8-cap catalog, 7 GUI-wired, proxy + honesty branch tested); 13-meter envelope + honest-quota doctrine + 3-runtime fixture tripwire (run fresh, green); audit seam (14 call sites, all in router.ex — the complete emission surface); token custody chain (6 reveal sites, all outbound-header-only) with fresh non-leak runs; button-wiring sweep (29/29 wired, zero noop); drafts.* = task-store only; charter pointers accurate; claim/stamp/close source read in full.

**Checked + NOT found (absences that matter):** no Studios/API/Datasets/Access/Plan pages (ratified exclusions, OC23); no full-edit webhook UI on any surface at main; **no click-simulation/fetch-mock harness anywhere in __app.test.mjs** (every interactive handler is JS-test-uncovered — whole-file standing debt, not webhook-specific); no client-side guard/test that the SPA never fetches /credentials (the guarantee rests on absence, not a tripwire); no committed psql one-liner for a usage_samples/agent_events DB-level proof; no top-level `bp search` verb in this CLI build (multiple scouts hit the wall; `bp search query` worked for some — CLI freshness inconsistency, run `make doctor`); no browser-level webhook click-through artifact from C6/C7 found.

**Unreached corners:** mountTimelineTab body (app.js:4532) never read in full; ~26 `.loading` spinner sites spot-checked, not exhaustively traced; the guerrilla box itself (SSH) untouched this cycle; `bp paper view` renders this paper as "no renderable blocks" while doc get works (unexplained, cosmetic).

### Verify plan — round 2 (in flight now)

| # | key | model | proves by RUNNING |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | w6-merge-train-proof | opus (worktree) | merge 30f59a6c → 050f87ee → c584cfc8 onto origin/main in an isolated worktree IN ORDER; `CC=clang mix test` usage + fixture + router_audit suites fresh at each step; then diff cloud router.ex mutating routes 39d27086→origin/main for NEW team-facing routes neither audit branch covers |
| 2 | webhook-edit-cli-gates | sonnet (worktree) | locate 22df63ab's branch, confirm the verb sends a full-field PUT, merge onto origin/main, run `CC=clang go build ./... && go vet ./internal/cli/... && go test ./internal/cli/...` |
| 3 | criterion1-gui-gap-and-spa-baseline | sonnet | prove no webhook edit UI at origin/main (grep) + SPA harness green: `node --check app.js && node __app.test.mjs`; confirm w6-webhook-edit-gui task still open/unclaimed; app.js:9180 stale comment still present |
| 4 | ledger-mechanics-proof | sonnet | read stamp.ex done-task guards + run its targeted test file; `gh` state of #2619/#2620/#2621 (issues only or PRs open?); live `bp task get` on all 5 w6 slices + c11-ledger-correction |

Decide will then: order the LEAD merge train (dbsize, then audit-lifecycle, then audit-settings-sites, then webhook-edit-cli), cut the one real build slice (webhook edit GUI + the 9180 comment fix bundled), execute the c11 ledger correction, stamp 1/2/4 only on merged + run evidence, and close the goal ONLY at 6/6 true with `--set observed_rev`.
## Decide — round 2 (2026-07-12): the landing wave

### What verification proved (4 reports, all with run output)

**w6-merge-train-proof (proven):** the Elixir train lands on today's main with ONE real conflict. Steps 1–2 (dbsize `30f59a6c`, audit-lifecycle `050f87ee`) merge clean; step 3 (`c584cfc8`) conflicts in `router_audit_test.exs` — both audit branches append describe blocks at the module tail. Decisive: keep-both-delete-markers BREAKS COMPILE (*"TokenMissingError … the do on line 876 does not have a matching end"*); the additive fix (two `end`s at the `=======` seam) yields *"128 tests, 0 failures"* fresh. Route drift is nil: router.ex byte-identical at base `39d27086` and main (blob `047443fc`), 101 mutating routes both sides — criterion 4's hole list is stable. Not-found: charter (out of the verifier's scope, by design).

**webhook-edit-cli-gates (proven, one caveat):** `22df63ab` merges clean onto main (*"2 files changed, 200 insertions"*), Go gates green ONLY with `CC=/usr/bin/clang` (*"error: unknown option '-E'"* under the cc alias; *"ok internal/cli 18.349s"* pinned). The edit verb PUTs name+url+events combined (TestWebhookEditPartialBody/combined PASS) — never `{active}`-only. REFUTED: the task's own "PR merged to main" met:true stamp — *no PR exists* (`gh pr list` empty both queries; `runWebhookEdit` absent from main). The shifted stamps were REPAIRED + republished at decide.

**criterion1-gui-gap-and-spa-baseline (digest premise REFUTED):** "webhook-edit-gui never built" was FALSE — built at `765dcacd` (data-wh-edit at app.js:3826/4102, *"394 tests, 394 pass"*, merges clean, zero conflict markers) and it already carries the app.js:9180 comment fix. Main baseline green (388/388); stale comment still on main; no PR/push for either webhook branch (`git ls-remote` empty).

**ledger-mechanics-proof (proven):** stamp-on-done is rejected unconditionally — fresh DB-backed run: *"STAMP-ON-DONE RESULT: {:error, {:not_in_progress, \"done\"}}"* — so the c11 correction MUST use the fallback task, not a re-stamp. #2619/#2620/#2621 are issues-only; none of the 5 branches were ever pushed. Bonus full-train dry-run: post-merge full suite *"1838 tests, 1 failure"* (pre-existing router_builder DB-pool flake, 27/27 isolated); Go + JS + preview smoke (28/28) all green. Also caught: the goal's wave_status heartbeat claiming "gui unbuilt" was stale.

### Decisions (mirrors charter OC29)

1. **This is a LANDING wave, not a build wave** — all five w6 slices are built gates-green on local-only branches; the wave pushes, PRs, merges, and finishes the ledger. Nothing new gets built.
2. **Merge train order is law** — dbsize → audit-lifecycle → audit-settings-sites; the one conflict resolves ONLY additively (two `end`s at the seam), proven by running the gate, never by eyeballing.
3. **Go gates pin `CC=/usr/bin/clang`** — the cc alias shadows the compiler; unpinned vet/test red spuriously.
4. **c11 correction goes straight to the fallback task** (`cloud-console-c11-ledger-correction`) — re-stamping the done c11 is proven impossible.
5. **No criterion text amendments this wave** — criterion 2 is fair as amended by OC11 (surveyor-verified airtight evidence pack); happy-path anchor close needs no `observed_rev` (fresh claim digests the already-amended text, OC28).
6. **Accept w5's guerrilla evidence for live proofs** — re-proof is a credential gate (proven twice); task-7100934ee7f33579's stamped cron samples are the citation.
7. **webhook-edit-cli's corrupted stamps repaired at decide** — evidence realigned to its criteria, "PR merged" back to met:false.

### Wave plan (3 slices; 1 ∥ 2 file-disjoint, 3 strictly LAST)

|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `cloud-console-w6l-elixir-merge-train` | Elixir control plane (push/PR/merge 30f59a6c → 050f87ee → c584cfc8, OC29(a) conflict recipe, then close the three w6 tasks) | fable | `cd cloud && CC=clang mix test test/barkpark_cloud/web/router_audit_test.exs test/barkpark_cloud/usage_test.exs test/barkpark_cloud/web/instance_api_proxy_test.exs` on the merged tree |
| 2 | `cloud-console-w6l-webhook-edit-land` | Go CLI + SPA (push/PR/merge 22df63ab + 765dcacd, then close both webhook tasks) | opus | `CC=/usr/bin/clang go build ./... && go vet ./internal/cli/... && go test ./internal/cli/...` AND `node --check cloud/priv/static/app.js && node cloud/priv/static/__app.test.mjs` (394/394) |
| 3 | `cloud-console-w6l-anchor-endgame` | ledger only (c11 correction via fallback; stamp anchor 1/2/4 with merge evidence; close `cloud-console-goal` at 6/6) | fable | `bp task get cloud-console-goal -o json` reads lifecycle done, criteria 6/6 met |

Backlog filed: `cloud-console-spa-interaction-harness` (p3 — no click-sim/fetch-mock harness exists in `__app.test.mjs`; wired handlers untested at interaction level). Decided against filing: guerrilla live re-proof (credential gate), SQL history bucketing (watch-item), webhook.show GUI surfacing (list already returns full objects).

Charter committed at `506f1e95` (OC29 + this wave plan). Review closes this paper as the debrief once the goal seals.

## DEBRIEF — Review (2026-07-12, wave reviewer; closes this paper)

**Grade: A-.** The wave did exactly what a landing wave exists to do and stayed honest at every fork; the minus is that only one of two landing slices reached main and the anchor remains open at 3/6 — the endgame is now a small, fully-specced ritual, but it is still owed.

### What shipped

| slice | task | outcome | final branch |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `cloud-console-w6l-elixir-merge-train` | **MERGED + task sealed done 4/4** | main (`f5554231` → `ecd1d878` → `e828714c`, PRs #2648/#2649/#2650) |
| 2 | `cloud-console-w6l-webhook-edit-land` | **review-green, UNMERGED** — lead merges | `loop-epic/land-the-webhook-full-edit-pair-cli-verb-1-r` (pushed) |
| 3 | `cloud-console-w6l-anchor-endgame` | **honestly stalled** — precondition false at run time; 4× `--miss` stamps; goal untouched | n/a (ledger-only) |

**Slice 1 review:** zero code fixes needed. The OC24 pattern law holds at every sampled call site — `audit_lifecycle_trigger` post-commit on the SUCCESS branch only for the 7 async triggers; transactional `Accounts.audit/3` for autoupdate/site-url/domain and the settings/github/sites cluster; the secrets law verified (studio-link audits THAT a link was minted, never the URL/ticket; github audits account_login, never the handle). The site-url wire-succeeded-audit-failed 422 path ("audit/3 refuses to report an unrecorded success") is exemplary honesty. Reviewer re-ran the gate trio FRESH at origin/main `e828714c`: **127 tests / 0 failures** (58 router_audit + 40 usage incl. the −1 sentinel regression at :272 + 29 proxy). The dry-run's "128" was off by one; the builder recorded it instead of chasing a phantom — correct call.

**Slice 2 review:** zero fixes needed; the `-r` branch is byte-identical to the builder's integration branch, pushed so it survives worktree cleanup. Verified adversarially: CLI partial-PUT presence semantics (flag KEY decides inclusion — `--name=""` clears, omitted keeps; `--events ""` → `[]`; zero-flag usage error fires before any network/resolve), GUI full-body PUT (never sends `active`, so an edit cannot resurrect a disabled hook), hostile-input escaping test-pinned, failure keeps the modal open with one `webhookMutationError` sentence (D25), first-ever `webhooks-panel` preview scenario with honest inert-click commentary. Gate green on the branch AND on the merge-tree with post-train main: zero conflicts, JS 394/394, smoke 28/28, go build/vet/test + gofmt clean (`CC=/usr/bin/clang`). The CLI-partial vs GUI-full divergence is documented on both sides — deliberate, not drift. **Merge guidance: merge-commit or rebase-merge (not squash) if the #2616/#2617 two-commit boundary matters; a single PR closing both issues is fine.**

**Slice 3 audit:** the stall is the SYSTEM WORKING — the brief's tripwire ("if not merged: stamp --miss and STOP") fired exactly as designed. At its run time origin/main was `1f147ff0` (pre-train); it verified five ground facts before stopping and left the goal's decide stamps intact. Its miss evidence is now half-stale (the train HAS merged) — re-dispatch only after the webhook merge, then the specced endgame (c11 correction → stamp 1/2/4 → close at 6/6, OC28 mechanics) runs unchanged.

### Ledger audit outcome

Everything was honest before review; one seal + one claim were the only mutations. (a) `cloud-console-w6l-elixir-merge-train` closed done 4/4 by the reviewer (all merges verified independently; observed_rev fence escape needed — OC28 held a third time). (b) `cloud-console-w6l-webhook-edit-land` re-claimed by the reviewer + pulsed with the review verdict; criteria honest (2/5 met — the 3 open are push/PR/merge + task-close, now lead work). (c) The three w6 Elixir tasks verified done with SHA+PR evidence; the two webhook w6 tasks verified honestly open on their merge criteria (cli 3/4, gui 4/5). (d) Goal verified open 3/6, decide stamps 0/3/5 intact, untouched by any builder — the never-stamp-over-a-gap law held. (e) Residue verified/filed: `task-d3248adeebec65a0` (TASK-SYSTEM.md doc-budget red on every PR — main-side, pay soon), `cloud-console-spa-interaction-harness` (p3), and NEW at review: `bp-pulse-epoch-bump-quirk` (p3 — `bp task pulse` bumps the claim epoch on every call; reproduced live during this review, 8→9 on a single pulse).

### What the next wave takes

1. **Lead:** merge `loop-epic/land-the-webhook-full-edit-pair-cli-verb-1-r` (Go+static-only, merges on its own gate — no Elixir Test wait; doc-gates red is the pre-existing main-side budget debt, not this branch), then close `cloud-console-w6-webhook-edit-cli` c3, `cloud-console-w6-webhook-edit-gui` c4, and w6l-webhook-edit-land criteria 0/1/4.
2. **Re-dispatch `cloud-console-w6l-anchor-endgame`** exactly as specced — its precondition becomes TRUE on that merge; it seals `cloud-console-goal` at 6/6 and closes `cloud-console-c11-ledger-correction`.
3. **Live glance (human/lead ritual):** guerrilla auto-deployed the train — check `/v1/usage` on a real instance for the db_size unmetered degrade; nobody has live-smoked it.
4. **Hygiene:** pay `task-d3248adeebec65a0` before red doc-gates train everyone to ignore them; `bp-pulse-epoch-bump-quirk` when convenient.

The wave-log entry mirroring this debrief is committed on branch `w6r-wave-log-review` (PR #2741, doc-only).</article>

# Cloud Console — Reconcile-the-Anchor Wave (2026-07-11)

**Epic anchor:** `cloud-console-goal` (p0, lifecycle `open`, 22/22 children done, **0/6 criteria stamped** despite five shipped waves C1–C7 + w2–w5). Charter: `.claude/workflows/bp-cloud-console-charter.md`.

**Status: REVIEWED / CLOSED as the wave debrief (2026-07-12)** — Elixir train MERGED (#2648/#2649/#2650); webhook pair review-green on `loop-epic/land-the-webhook-full-edit-pair-cli-verb-1-r`, awaiting the lead's merge; anchor endgame honestly stalled on its precondition (re-dispatch after the webhook merge). Goal still open at 3/6 — never stamped over the gap. See DEBRIEF at the bottom. *(Correction note: this line previously read 'webhook-edit-gui unbuilt' — that premise was FALSE, corrected at Decide round 2 / OC29: the GUI was built at 765dcacd.)*

## The Wish (verbatim)

CLOUD CONSOLE — RECONCILE THE ANCHOR + TAKE THE HONEST NEXT LEVER. (1) verify each anchor criterion at HEAD with file:line + PR + fresh run/live proof — stamp what is TRUE (the meters/quotas criterion is likely fully evidenced by w2+w5; webhooks GUI shipped in C-waves — verify it end-to-end, not from memory). (2) For criteria with REAL gaps (candidates: Plan tab parked on plan truth cloud-17; any dead/decorative panel; audit-event coverage holes), either cut honest build slices this wave or park with a named blocker — never stamp over a gap. (3) Consume or retire the charter's stale next-wave pointers (machine-meter is DONE; live TREND eyeball is a lead/human ritual — park with recipe if unautomatable; worst-state accents stay parked on cloud-17). If all six criteria end met, close the goal via the close verb; if not, leave it open with the residue filed as children. Hard laws: never close over an unverified criterion; publish-collapse every drafts.* touch (sweep drafts.cloud-console-c10-members-usage, -c11-live-meters, -rollback-gui, -dec-*); human gates stay open with recipes; builders claim their bp task FIRST; Elixir changes wait for the Elixir Test gate; guerrilla deploys ONLY via instance-deploy.sh. File residue under cloud-console-goal.

## Strategy (wave direction)

This is the **honest-audit endgame wave**, not a feature wave. Five waves of building outran the ledger; the deliverable now is a stamp trail, not a screen. The finished state:

1. **Each of the six anchor criteria carries evidence at HEAD** — file:line + PR# + a fresh run or live-guerrilla proof — and is stamped `met:true` only where the words are actually true. Expected verdicts going in (to be overturned by evidence, not memory):
   - *meters = per-instance truth + quotas + warnings* — likely fully evidenced: w2 quota truth (#1966), w3 sampler, w4 history/sparklines, w5 machine meters (task-7100934ee7f33579, live-proven on guerrilla 2026-07-10). Per OC25 the criterion stays as worded → the **GUI edit modal is the wave's one real remaining BUILD**; the CLI edit verb is built on the 22df63ab branch (unmerged).
6. **Criterion 5** re-proven with fresh runs (5/5 provisioning non-leak + 27/27 studio-link/rollback/self-update refute-token tests); SSE module has zero admin_token references; `/credentials` is the one deliberate, admin-gated, CLI-only escape hatch — never fetched by app.js (0 grep hits).
7. **Drafts sweep**: the six `drafts.cloud-console-*` ids are TASK-store records, not doc-store drafts (24 lookups not_found) — publish-collapse is a category error, confirming OC27. `c11-live-meters` is the one genuine false-done (criterion 3 met:false, empty evidence); correction task `cloud-console-c11-ledger-correction` (#2625) filed, gated on the dbsize merge. The three dec-* stubs are legitimately closed-as-superseded via close_reason pointers.
8. **Charter pointers**: all four wave-4/5 pointers verified consumed and accurate at HEAD. Sole residue: the stale `app.js:9180` ceiling comment, which rides the unbuilt webhook-edit-gui slice — must stay explicitly bundled or it drops off every plate.
9. **Live-guerrilla re-proof is a CREDENTIAL GATE** (proven twice live: this session's cloud team owns 0 barkparks). The w5 stamped evidence (task-7100934ee7f33579, real cron samples 2026-07-10) stands as the citation; Decide should accept it rather than spend a verifier on an unreachable box.
10. **Close mechanics** code-verified at source: fresh targeted claim (epoch 7→8, lifecycle open→in_progress), stamp per-criterion with evidence-or-miss, amending criterion TEXT freezes the work-digest → close must pass `--set observed_rev=<fresh rev>`, close never touches children/parent_id.

### Contradictions resolved / still open

- RESOLVED: merged-vs-unmerged (see 1). RESOLVED: the charter's "criterion 3 stamped at decide" note is real, not aspirational (goal task shows it, and the decorative sweep independently re-verified clean).
- OPEN → verify round: do the three Elixir branches merge CLEANLY onto today's main (drift since 39d27086: azure-restore #2610, provisioner #2609/#2614, MCP #2628 landed since — did any add unaudited team-facing mutating routes to cloud router.ex)? Do their gates pass FRESH post-merge, in order?
- OPEN → verify round: does `bp task stamp` reject stamps on a done task with a closed claim? (The c11 correction fallback recipe depends on the answer.)
- OPEN → verify round: does the webhook-edit-cli branch pass Go gates on top of today's main, and does its verb actually send a full-field PUT?

### Coverage map (NOT-FOUNDs are decisions-in-waiting)

**Checked + found:** full nav→route→test truth table (14 shipped places, every one live + tested; members coverage hides in the misleadingly-named router_invitations_test.exs); webhook capability chain (8-cap catalog, 7 GUI-wired, proxy + honesty branch tested); 13-meter envelope + honest-quota doctrine + 3-runtime fixture tripwire (run fresh, green); audit seam (14 call sites, all in router.ex — the complete emission surface); token custody chain (6 reveal sites, all outbound-header-only) with fresh non-leak runs; button-wiring sweep (29/29 wired, zero noop); drafts.* = task-store only; charter pointers accurate; claim/stamp/close source read in full.

**Checked + NOT found (absences that matter):** no Studios/API/Datasets/Access/Plan pages (ratified exclusions, OC23); no full-edit webhook UI on any surface at main; **no click-simulation/fetch-mock harness anywhere in __app.test.mjs** (every interactive handler is JS-test-uncovered — whole-file standing debt, not webhook-specific); no client-side guard/test that the SPA never fetches /credentials (the guarantee rests on absence, not a tripwire); no committed psql one-liner for a usage_samples/agent_events DB-level proof; no top-level `bp search` verb in this CLI build (multiple scouts hit the wall; `bp search query` worked for some — CLI freshness inconsistency, run `make doctor`); no browser-level webhook click-through artifact from C6/C7 found.

**Unreached corners:** mountTimelineTab body (app.js:4532) never read in full; ~26 `.loading` spinner sites spot-checked, not exhaustively traced; the guerrilla box itself (SSH) untouched this cycle; `bp paper view` renders this paper as "no renderable blocks" while doc get works (unexplained, cosmetic).

### Verify plan — round 2 (in flight now)

| # | key | model | proves by RUNNING |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | w6-merge-train-proof | opus (worktree) | merge 30f59a6c → 050f87ee → c584cfc8 onto origin/main in an isolated worktree IN ORDER; `CC=clang mix test` usage + fixture + router_audit suites fresh at each step; then diff cloud router.ex mutating routes 39d27086→origin/main for NEW team-facing routes neither audit branch covers |
| 2 | webhook-edit-cli-gates | sonnet (worktree) | locate 22df63ab's branch, confirm the verb sends a full-field PUT, merge onto origin/main, run `CC=clang go build ./... && go vet ./internal/cli/... && go test ./internal/cli/...` |
| 3 | criterion1-gui-gap-and-spa-baseline | sonnet | prove no webhook edit UI at origin/main (grep) + SPA harness green: `node --check app.js && node __app.test.mjs`; confirm w6-webhook-edit-gui task still open/unclaimed; app.js:9180 stale comment still present |
| 4 | ledger-mechanics-proof | sonnet | read stamp.ex done-task guards + run its targeted test file; `gh` state of #2619/#2620/#2621 (issues only or PRs open?); live `bp task get` on all 5 w6 slices + c11-ledger-correction |

Decide will then: order the LEAD merge train (dbsize, then audit-lifecycle, then audit-settings-sites, then webhook-edit-cli), cut the one real build slice (webhook edit GUI + the 9180 comment fix bundled), execute the c11 ledger correction, stamp 1/2/4 only on merged + run evidence, and close the goal ONLY at 6/6 true with `--set observed_rev`.
## Decide — round 2 (2026-07-12): the landing wave

### What verification proved (4 reports, all with run output)

**w6-merge-train-proof (proven):** the Elixir train lands on today's main with ONE real conflict. Steps 1–2 (dbsize `30f59a6c`, audit-lifecycle `050f87ee`) merge clean; step 3 (`c584cfc8`) conflicts in `router_audit_test.exs` — both audit branches append describe blocks at the module tail. Decisive: keep-both-delete-markers BREAKS COMPILE (*"TokenMissingError … the do on line 876 does not have a matching end"*); the additive fix (two `end`s at the `=======` seam) yields *"128 tests, 0 failures"* fresh. Route drift is nil: router.ex byte-identical at base `39d27086` and main (blob `047443fc`), 101 mutating routes both sides — criterion 4's hole list is stable. Not-found: charter (out of the verifier's scope, by design).

**webhook-edit-cli-gates (proven, one caveat):** `22df63ab` merges clean onto main (*"2 files changed, 200 insertions"*), Go gates green ONLY with `CC=/usr/bin/clang` (*"error: unknown option '-E'"* under the cc alias; *"ok internal/cli 18.349s"* pinned). The edit verb PUTs name+url+events combined (TestWebhookEditPartialBody/combined PASS) — never `{active}`-only. REFUTED: the task's own "PR merged to main" met:true stamp — *no PR exists* (`gh pr list` empty both queries; `runWebhookEdit` absent from main). The shifted stamps were REPAIRED + republished at decide.

**criterion1-gui-gap-and-spa-baseline (digest premise REFUTED):** "webhook-edit-gui never built" was FALSE — built at `765dcacd` (data-wh-edit at app.js:3826/4102, *"394 tests, 394 pass"*, merges clean, zero conflict markers) and it already carries the app.js:9180 comment fix. Main baseline green (388/388); stale comment still on main; no PR/push for either webhook branch (`git ls-remote` empty).

**ledger-mechanics-proof (proven):** stamp-on-done is rejected unconditionally — fresh DB-backed run: *"STAMP-ON-DONE RESULT: {:error, {:not_in_progress, \"done\"}}"* — so the c11 correction MUST use the fallback task, not a re-stamp. #2619/#2620/#2621 are issues-only; none of the 5 branches were ever pushed. Bonus full-train dry-run: post-merge full suite *"1838 tests, 1 failure"* (pre-existing router_builder DB-pool flake, 27/27 isolated); Go + JS + preview smoke (28/28) all green. Also caught: the goal's wave_status heartbeat claiming "gui unbuilt" was stale.

### Decisions (mirrors charter OC29)

1. **This is a LANDING wave, not a build wave** — all five w6 slices are built gates-green on local-only branches; the wave pushes, PRs, merges, and finishes the ledger. Nothing new gets built.
2. **Merge train order is law** — dbsize → audit-lifecycle → audit-settings-sites; the one conflict resolves ONLY additively (two `end`s at the seam), proven by running the gate, never by eyeballing.
3. **Go gates pin `CC=/usr/bin/clang`** — the cc alias shadows the compiler; unpinned vet/test red spuriously.
4. **c11 correction goes straight to the fallback task** (`cloud-console-c11-ledger-correction`) — re-stamping the done c11 is proven impossible.
5. **No criterion text amendments this wave** — criterion 2 is fair as amended by OC11 (surveyor-verified airtight evidence pack); happy-path anchor close needs no `observed_rev` (fresh claim digests the already-amended text, OC28).
6. **Accept w5's guerrilla evidence for live proofs** — re-proof is a credential gate (proven twice); task-7100934ee7f33579's stamped cron samples are the citation.
7. **webhook-edit-cli's corrupted stamps repaired at decide** — evidence realigned to its criteria, "PR merged" back to met:false.

### Wave plan (3 slices; 1 ∥ 2 file-disjoint, 3 strictly LAST)

| # | task | surface | model | gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `cloud-console-w6l-elixir-merge-train` | Elixir control plane (push/PR/merge 30f59a6c → 050f87ee → c584cfc8, OC29(a) conflict recipe, then close the three w6 tasks) | fable | `cd cloud && CC=clang mix test test/barkpark_cloud/web/router_audit_test.exs test/barkpark_cloud/usage_test.exs test/barkpark_cloud/web/instance_api_proxy_test.exs` on the merged tree |
| 2 | `cloud-console-w6l-webhook-edit-land` | Go CLI + SPA (push/PR/merge 22df63ab + 765dcacd, then close both webhook tasks) | opus | `CC=/usr/bin/clang go build ./... && go vet ./internal/cli/... && go test ./internal/cli/...` AND `node --check cloud/priv/static/app.js && node cloud/priv/static/__app.test.mjs` (394/394) |
| 3 | `cloud-console-w6l-anchor-endgame` | ledger only (c11 correction via fallback; stamp anchor 1/2/4 with merge evidence; close `cloud-console-goal` at 6/6) | fable | `bp task get cloud-console-goal -o json` reads lifecycle done, criteria 6/6 met |

Backlog filed: `cloud-console-spa-interaction-harness` (p3 — no click-sim/fetch-mock harness exists in `__app.test.mjs`; wired handlers untested at interaction level). Decided against filing: guerrilla live re-proof (credential gate), SQL history bucketing (watch-item), webhook.show GUI surfacing (list already returns full objects).

Charter committed at `506f1e95` (OC29 + this wave plan). Review closes this paper as the debrief once the goal seals.

## DEBRIEF — Review (2026-07-12, wave reviewer; closes this paper)

**Grade: A-.** The wave did exactly what a landing wave exists to do and stayed honest at every fork; the minus is that only one of two landing slices reached main and the anchor remains open at 3/6 — the endgame is now a small, fully-specced ritual, but it is still owed.

### What shipped

| slice | task | outcome | final branch |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `cloud-console-w6l-elixir-merge-train` | **MERGED + task sealed done 4/4** | main (`f5554231` → `ecd1d878` → `e828714c`, PRs #2648/#2649/#2650) |
| 2 | `cloud-console-w6l-webhook-edit-land` | **review-green, UNMERGED** — lead merges | `loop-epic/land-the-webhook-full-edit-pair-cli-verb-1-r` (pushed) |
| 3 | `cloud-console-w6l-anchor-endgame` | **honestly stalled** — precondition false at run time; 4× `--miss` stamps; goal untouched | n/a (ledger-only) |

**Slice 1 review:** zero code fixes needed. The OC24 pattern law holds at every sampled call site — `audit_lifecycle_trigger` post-commit on the SUCCESS branch only for the 7 async triggers; transactional `Accounts.audit/3` for autoupdate/site-url/domain and the settings/github/sites cluster; the secrets law verified (studio-link audits THAT a link was minted, never the URL/ticket; github audits account_login, never the handle). The site-url wire-succeeded-audit-failed 422 path ("audit/3 refuses to report an unrecorded success") is exemplary honesty. Reviewer re-ran the gate trio FRESH at origin/main `e828714c`: **127 tests / 0 failures** (58 router_audit + 40 usage incl. the −1 sentinel regression at :272 + 29 proxy). The dry-run's "128" was off by one; the builder recorded it instead of chasing a phantom — correct call.

**Slice 2 review:** zero fixes needed; the `-r` branch is byte-identical to the builder's integration branch, pushed so it survives worktree cleanup. Verified adversarially: CLI partial-PUT presence semantics (flag KEY decides inclusion — `--name=""` clears, omitted keeps; `--events ""` → `[]`; zero-flag usage error fires before any network/resolve), GUI full-body PUT (never sends `active`, so an edit cannot resurrect a disabled hook), hostile-input escaping test-pinned, failure keeps the modal open with one `webhookMutationError` sentence (D25), first-ever `webhooks-panel` preview scenario with honest inert-click commentary. Gate green on the branch AND on the merge-tree with post-train main: zero conflicts, JS 394/394, smoke 28/28, go build/vet/test + gofmt clean (`CC=/usr/bin/clang`). The CLI-partial vs GUI-full divergence is documented on both sides — deliberate, not drift. **Merge guidance: merge-commit or rebase-merge (not squash) if the #2616/#2617 two-commit boundary matters; a single PR closing both issues is fine.**

**Slice 3 audit:** the stall is the SYSTEM WORKING — the brief's tripwire ("if not merged: stamp --miss and STOP") fired exactly as designed. At its run time origin/main was `1f147ff0` (pre-train); it verified five ground facts before stopping and left the goal's decide stamps intact. Its miss evidence is now half-stale (the train HAS merged) — re-dispatch only after the webhook merge, then the specced endgame (c11 correction → stamp 1/2/4 → close at 6/6, OC28 mechanics) runs unchanged.

### Ledger audit outcome

Everything was honest before review; one seal + one claim were the only mutations. (a) `cloud-console-w6l-elixir-merge-train` closed done 4/4 by the reviewer (all merges verified independently; observed_rev fence escape needed — OC28 held a third time). (b) `cloud-console-w6l-webhook-edit-land` re-claimed by the reviewer + pulsed with the review verdict; criteria honest (2/5 met — the 3 open are push/PR/merge + task-close, now lead work). (c) The three w6 Elixir tasks verified done with SHA+PR evidence; the two webhook w6 tasks verified honestly open on their merge criteria (cli 3/4, gui 4/5). (d) Goal verified open 3/6, decide stamps 0/3/5 intact, untouched by any builder — the never-stamp-over-a-gap law held. (e) Residue verified/filed: `task-d3248adeebec65a0` (TASK-SYSTEM.md doc-budget red on every PR — main-side, pay soon), `cloud-console-spa-interaction-harness` (p3), and NEW at review: `bp-pulse-epoch-bump-quirk` (p3 — `bp task pulse` bumps the claim epoch on every call; reproduced live during this review, 8→9 on a single pulse).

### What the next wave takes

1. **Lead:** merge `loop-epic/land-the-webhook-full-edit-pair-cli-verb-1-r` (Go+static-only, merges on its own gate — no Elixir Test wait; doc-gates red is the pre-existing main-side budget debt, not this branch), then close `cloud-console-w6-webhook-edit-cli` c3, `cloud-console-w6-webhook-edit-gui` c4, and w6l-webhook-edit-land criteria 0/1/4.
2. **Re-dispatch `cloud-console-w6l-anchor-endgame`** exactly as specced — its precondition becomes TRUE on that merge; it seals `cloud-console-goal` at 6/6 and closes `cloud-console-c11-ledger-correction`.
3. **Live glance (human/lead ritual):** guerrilla auto-deployed the train — check `/v1/usage` on a real instance for the db_size unmetered degrade; nobody has live-smoked it.
4. **Hygiene:** pay `task-d3248adeebec65a0` before red doc-gates train everyone to ignore them; `bp-pulse-epoch-bump-quirk` when convenient.

The wave-log entry mirroring this debrief is committed on branch `w6r-wave-log-review` (PR #2741, doc-only).
